_note: Progression scaling coefficients. All companion thresholds compressed by ratio ~0.5x from Pass-1 baselines, preserving relative difficulty between types: Wildfolk (1.0x base), CapturedMonster (0.75x of Wildfolk), HiredHero (1.0-1.25x), BoundShade (1.5x), ArdweldConstruct (3x). Compression matches progression-sim Pass-1 recommendation for Wildfolk and is propagated proportionally so non-Wildfolk types accelerate at the same relative rate.

companionRubberBand._note: Companion XP catch-up scaling. When a companion's effective 'expected level' (layer × playerLevelWeight) trails the player's level, usage points are multiplied by 1 + gap*perGapBonus (clamped to maxMultiplier). Near-matching companions see ~1.0 (no bonus); far-lagging layer-1 companions at L30 get the 3× cap. Formula: mult = clamp(1 + max(0, playerLevel - layer*playerLevelWeight) * perGapBonus, 1.0, maxMultiplier).

craftingSkillScaling._note: Skill-scaled tolerance on CraftingService quantity check (task #133). Formula: tolerance = clamp(baseTolerance + max(0, craftingSkill/max(1,requiredCraftingSkill) - 1) * tolerancePerSkillTier, baseTolerance, maxTolerance). At skill == required: baseTolerance (5%). At skill = 2x required: 7%. At skill = 4x required: 11%. Capped at maxTolerance so legendary crafters still face real risk on the hardest recipes.
